This is a followup to this post in which I vented my frustration about not being able to find clothes that fit me. Most of it is basically just me being salty about not being able to fill out pants, so the tl;dr part is bolded below if you'd like to skip all that.

So yesterday I went to the mall and here are my findings:

  1. No luck at Pacsun. If you're above a size 3 they seem to believe you must be a fupa troopa and their pants are cut as such.

  2. Zumiez is also (almost) eliminated as well, at least pants-wise. This is the one I'm saddest about by far since I really like this store. I was able to find one brand of pants, "Almost Famous," that fit but they have plastic thread and don't feel of the best quality. I only bought one pair. Zumiez's own brand, Empire, doesn't fit me at all now (which sucks bc they made up a large margin of my favorite pants before).

3. Express ended up being the holy grail. However only some styles fit me. Their midrise leggings to be precise. Best option by far, and good quality, but pricey.

Good luck to you, my fellow shitladies :)

I've actually had a lot of luck in TJMaxx and Marshalls lately. They have extras and overstock from places like Belk and Dillard's, so a lot of times the fits are unusual but work well for humans. The one in my town only has a single obeast rack.

Same, my best fitting pants are from Marshalls lately. Smaller sizes of "curvy" cut pants seem to end up there, which is just what I need.

Also I love your username. The great valley ftw.

Have you tried New York and Company? I wear a size 0/2 (depending on the store and brand) and love their jean quality. Idk your size but NYC likes to vanity size so only some 0 sized styles fit me, but you may have some luck! I've owned a pair for three years so quality is well worth the price (~$60 a pair)

Edit: their two fits like a 4 and their 0 fits like small 2. If that helps? American sizes if I may include*
As a shitlord, I can't really weigh in. But isn't American Eagle pretty accurate for the fairer sex? It is the only store I know that carries jeans in at least near true size (if flex fit).

Are you in the US or Canada? There's a few stores up here I could recommend if you need dress pants. Le Chateau and Laura Petites both have good quality stuff, but are pricey. I think they also have online stores that ship to the states, but the return process for Le Chateau is a pain in the ass and they vanity size - I'm 5'7" 125 lbs and measurements 36-26-38 and I take a 4 in the pants and a S or XS in the tops, just to give you an idea.

If you need jeans, check out Silver Jeans Co. Again they're another Canadian brand but they don't vanity size as far as I can tell. And the jeans don't do that thing where the waistband sticks out at the back, cuz I have a curvy behind (the good kind of curvy) and they fit perfectly. Pretty sure they ship to the states too.

Good luck!
